# Quick Build Summary

| Field | Value |

## Request

> add a simple bun utility script that validates JSON input from stdin

## Summary

Created a new Bun utility script that reads JSON from stdin and validates it, outputting the parsed JSON if valid or an error message if invalid. The script exits with code 0 for valid JSON and code 1 for invalid.

## Changes

| File | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `src/validate-json.ts` | Added | Main utility script with validateJson function and stdin reader |
| `src/validate-json.test.ts` | Added | Unit tests for validateJson function |

## Key Decisions

- Exported `validateJson` function for reusability in other modules
- Used TypeScript interface `ValidationResult` for type-safe return values
- Script is executable with shebang and can be run directly with `bun run`
- Handles edge cases: empty input, whitespace-only input, all JSON types (objects, arrays, primitives)
- Provides human-readable error messages from JSON parse errors

## Verification

| Check | Status |
|-------|--------|
| Format | OK |
| Lint | OK |
| Tests | 10/10 OK |

## Notes

- Manual testing confirmed stdin piping works correctly
- Exit codes properly set (0 for valid, 1 for invalid)
- Script follows existing codebase patterns (JSDoc comments, TypeScript, bun:test)
